description: This file defines the EditSocialMediaAuthProviderController class for the OrangeHRM OpenID authentication plugin. It extends a base Vue controller to prepare a component for editing social media authentication providers, configuring the component with an ID if provided in the request.

classes.name: EditSocialMediaAuthProviderController
classes.description: Controller handling the editing of social media authentication providers within the OrangeHRM OpenID plugin. Prepares Vue component with optional 'id' property based on the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, setting the 'edit-auth-provider' component with an 'id' property if available in request attributes.
